problem: Geoffrey R. Grimmett, Selected Problems in Probability Theory, Conjecture 4.2

scope.graphs: all finite simple graphs on exactly 8 vertices, including disconnected graphs
scope.measure: uniform over all acyclic edge subsets (all forests, isolated vertices allowed)
scope.property: pairwise edge negative correlation for every distinct present edge pair

coverage.construction: all 1044 unlabeled 7-vertex graph atlas classes; add an eighth vertex with all 2^7 neighborhoods; exact NetworkX isomorphism deduplication inside isomorphism-invariant prefilter buckets

exact_checker.method: Kirchhoff/Matrix-Tree component counts plus exact forest component dynamic programming and exact first/second edge-inclusion counts; Rayleigh numerators accumulated as integers

independent_self_check.method: independent brute-force enumeration of all acyclic edge subsets of K8

literature_cross_check.grimmett_winkler_2004: published numerical verification for all graphs on at most 8 vertices, and 9 vertices with at most 18 edges

limitations: This certificate is only the source's unweighted pairwise statement; it does not certify the all-positive-rational-weight I-Rayleigh property.
It does not certify full negative association for arbitrary increasing events on disjoint edge sets.
The published 9-vertex <=18-edge computation is partial at n=9 and therefore does not advance the complete-size metric beyond 8.
The emitted graph6 catalog itself is reproducibly generated and hash-certified but is not separately stored in this repository; the deterministic generator and complete execution manifest are stored.
